blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robust skeleton-based action recognition requires representations that capture a wide spectrum of motions, from subtle to moderate and strong ones. Existing methods often focus on strong motions. This paper introduces DiMoP, a masking- and diffusion-driven motion representation learning method with frame-level pseudo-classification to explicitly learn the distribution of joint motions rather than regressing deterministic coordinates, as existing methods often do. By diffusing masked joints with progressive noise and denoising them conditioned on visible joints, DiMoP learns through controllable noising and denoising processes, enabling uniform learning of weak, moderate, and strong dynamics. To enable the masking-based generative diffusion learning with a discriminative capability, a pseudo-frame classifier is proposed that enforces the learning towards sequence-consistent and temporally coherent pseudo-labels without manual annotations. Together, these strategies provide a principled mechanism for joint generative and discriminative motion modeling. DiMoP achieves state-of-the-art performance across NTU RGB+D 60/120, and PKUMMD, including a 1.1 percentage point gain over prior works on NTU RGB+D 120 with the cross-subject protocol. The code is available at DiMoP.
blocks.zh: 强有力的基于骨架的行动识别要求表达,能够捕捉从微妙到温和和强势的广泛运动。 现有方法往往侧重于强烈的运动。 本文引入了DiMoP,这是一种蒙面和扩散驱动的运动表达学习方法,带有帧级伪分类,以明确学习联合运动的分布,而不是像现有方法通常那样倒退决定坐标. DiMOP通过将遮罩的关节与进步噪声分泌,并以可见的关节为条件去Noing,通过可控的点名和去noing过程学习,使得能够统一学习弱,中,强的动态. 为使基于遮掩的基因扩散学习具有歧视性能力,建议采用伪框架分类法,在没有人工说明的情况下,强制学习序列一致和时间一致的伪标签。 这些战略共同提供了一个原则性机制,用于建立联合遗传性和歧视性运动模型。 DiMoP实现全NTU RGB+D 60/120,以及PKUMMD的最先进性能,包括比之前与交叉主体协议的NTU RGB+D 120的作品提高1.1个百分点. 该代码可在DiMoP获取.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Human action recognition is required in many diverse applications, including video surveillance, autonomous driving, robotics, healthcare monitoring, and industrial safety. It enables the detection of hazardous events, abnormal behaviors, and work-efficiency patterns. Compared with RGB-based methods [ 1 , 2 ] , skeleton data, obtainable from CCTV systems or commodity 3D cameras, has emerged as an efficient and robust alternative due to its lower computational cost and reduced sensitivity to environmental variations [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 在许多不同的应用中,包括视频监视、自主驾驶、机器人、保健监测和工业安全,都要求承认人类行动。 它能够发现危险事件、异常行为和工作效率模式。 与基于RGB的方法[1,2]相比,从闭路电视系统或商品3D摄像头获得的骨架数据,由于计算成本较低,对环境变化的敏感性降低[3],因此已经成为一种高效和强有力的替代品.

blocks.en: There has been significant progress in supervised action recognition [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Despite this progress, performance remains highly dependent on large amounts of annotated training data. Collecting and annotating extensive datasets in the real-world is labor- and time-intensive. Consequently, unsupervised and self-supervised methods have emerged as promising alternatives [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 在监督行动确认方面取得了重大进展[4、5、6、7、8、9]。 尽管取得了这些进展,但业绩仍然高度依赖大量附加说明的培训数据。 收集和说明现实世界的广泛数据集是劳动和时间密集型的。 因此,出现了不受监督和自我监督的替代方法[10、11、12、13、14、15]。

blocks.en: In self-supervised learning (SSL), learned representations are required to capture the intrinsic structure and distribution of the data without annotations to enhance downstream performance. To this end, various pre-training approaches are employed to learn effective representations. These approaches can be broadly categorized into two groups: contrastive methods [ 13 , 14 , 10 , 16 ] and generative methods [ 12 , 17 , 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 在自我监督的学习(SSL)中,需要学习的表达来捕捉数据的内在结构和分布,而不附加说明,以提高下游的性能. 为此,采用了各种培训前方法来学习有效的表述。 这些方法大致可分为两类:对比方法[13、14、10、16]和遗传方法[12、17、18]。

blocks.en: Contrastive approaches employ various transformations to approximate the data distribution in the real world. Typically, handcrafted transformations, such as random cropping, scaling, rotations, and temporal jittering, are used to generate multiple views of the same instance, thereby enhancing data diversity [ 14 , 16 ] . However, these operations provide only limited stochasticity and fail to simulate the true probabilistic distribution of motion dynamics, ultimately oversimplifying the complex and uncertain behaviors inherent in skeletal movements, particularly the subtle movements.
blocks.zh: 相互矛盾的方法采用各种转变来估计现实世界的数据分布。 通常情况下,手动转换,如随机裁剪,缩放,旋转,以及时间抖动,都用于生成对同一实例的多种视图,从而增强数据多样性[14,16]. 然而,这些操作只能提供有限的花纹,无法模拟运动动力学的真正概率分布,最终过度简化了骨骼运动固有的复杂和不确定的行为,特别是微妙的运动.

blocks.en: Recent generative methods typically adopt the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) [ 19 ] framework for representation learning by reconstructing masked joints or body parts from unmasked or visible joints [ 12 , 17 , 18 ] . In these methods, random [ 11 , 12 ] or sample-dependent masking [ 17 ] is often used. Although this design effectively models the relationship between unmasked and masked parts and captures their dynamics, the direct prediction of masked joints from unmasked joints often fails to learn subtle dynamics due to the simultaneous coexistence of weak and strong dynamics , leading to ineffective modeling of subtle motion in the presence of highly complex and dynamic motion patterns in the real world and, hence, compromising the generalization of the learned representations.
blocks.zh: 近期的基因方法通常采用蒙面自动编码器[(MAE)[19]框架,通过从未蒙面或可见关节重建蒙面的关节或身体部位[(12,17,18)]来进行代表学习. 在这些方法中,常使用随机[11,12]或依赖样本的遮罩[17]. 虽然这种设计有效地模拟了未蒙面和遮盖部分之间的关系,并抓住了它们的动态,但由于弱和强的动态同时并存,对未蒙面的关节的直接预测往往无法学习到微妙的动态,导致在现实世界中高度复杂和动态的运动模式的存在下,对微妙运动的模型化无效,从而损害了所学表现的概括化.

blocks.en: To improve the learning of subtle motion and the discriminative power of the learned representation, this paper proposes a framework for Di ffusion-Driven Mo tion Representation Learning with Frame-Level P seudo-classification, referred to as DiMoP. DiMoP is a joint diffusion-based generative and unsupervised discriminative learning model. First, DiMoP randomly selects joints and gradually diffuses them with controlled Gaussian noise, followed by denoising conditioned on the representation of visible joints. This progressive diffusion trajectory compels the model to learn subtle motion variations in the early steps and high-energy dynamics in the later steps, providing a principled mechanism that treats all motion scales equally: subtle, moderate, and strong. Second, a frame-based pseudo-classification module is introduced to enhance the discriminativeness of the learned motion representation. The pseudo-classification module transforms a sequence of uniformly distributed random numbers of the same length as the action sequence into a frame-based pseudo-action label, conditioned upon the learned motion representation of the unmasked joints or parts. Note that we refer to the module as a pseudo-frame-based classifier or a pseudo-classifier because the actual action label is unknown, and the classifier aims to enforce the learned representation to achieve consistent and temporally coherent frame-based labels for the entire sequence.
blocks.zh: 为了改进对微妙运动的学习,以及学习到的代表的歧视性力量,本文提出了用Framle-Level Peudo分类法来进行 Difusion-Driven Motion 代表学习的框架,称为 DiMoP. DiMoP是一种基于传播的联合基因和无监督的歧视性学习模式. 首先,DiMOP随机选择关节,并逐渐以受控的高斯噪声扩散,然后以可见关节的表示为解诺条件. 这种渐进扩散的轨迹迫使模型在早期步骤中学习微妙的运动变化,在后期步骤中学习高能量动力学,提供了一个原则机制,对所有运动尺度一视同仁:微妙、中和强。 其次,采用了基于帧的伪分类模块,以提高学习运动表现的歧视性. 伪分类模块将与动作序列相同长度的一致分布随机数的序列转换为帧式伪动作标签,以未面罩关节或部件的学习运动表现为条件. 请注意,我们把模块称为伪帧分类器或伪分类器,因为实际动作标签未知,分类器旨在强制执行学到的表示,实现整个序列的一致和时间上一致的帧标签.

blocks.en: The key contributions of this work are summarized as follows: 1. A generative-discriminative framework, DiMoP, is proposed. DiMoP replaces deterministic masking with a progressive noise–denoise process, enabling the model to fully capture the joint motion distribution and effectively learn the subtle, moderate, and strong dynamics. These capabilities are often lacking in existing masking-based methods. 2. The introduction and integration of a pseudo-frame-based classifier module into DiMoP enhance the discriminative power of the learned motion representation. This mechanism effectively enforces explicitly discriminative learning in a diffusion-based generative model. 3. Extensive experiments were conducted on four benchmark datasets to demonstrate that the proposed generative–discriminative design consistently yields state-of-the-art or competitive performance, thereby validating its effectiveness for skeleton representation learning.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 提出了基因歧视框架DiMoP。 DiMoP用一个渐进的噪声-隐形过程来取代决定性的遮盖,使模型能够充分捕捉联合运动分布,并有效学习微妙的,温和的,强大的动态. 这些能力往往缺乏现有的隐蔽方法。 2. 在DiMOP中引入和整合一个基于伪框架的分类器模块,增强了学习运动表现的歧视性力量. 这种机制在基于传播的基因模型中有效地实施明确的歧视性学习。 3. 对四个基准数据集进行了广泛的试验,以表明拟议的基因差别设计始终能产生最先进的或具有竞争力的性能,从而证实其对骨干代表性学习的有效性。

blocks.en: A generative-discriminative framework, DiMoP, is proposed. DiMoP replaces deterministic masking with a progressive noise–denoise process, enabling the model to fully capture the joint motion distribution and effectively learn the subtle, moderate, and strong dynamics. These capabilities are often lacking in existing masking-based methods.

blocks.zh: 在DiMoP中引入并整合了假帧分类器模块,增强了学习运动表现的歧视性力量. 这种机制在基于传播的基因模型中有效地实施明确的歧视性学习。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: This section briefly reviews recent advances in supervised and self-supervised skeleton-based action recognition.
blocks.zh: 本节简要回顾在监督和自我监督的骨干行动确认方面的最新进展。

blocks.en: II-A Supervised Methods
blocks.zh: 监督方法

blocks.en: In early-stage works, CNN [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] and RNN [ 23 , 24 ] architectures were often employed for action recognition, while more recent studies have been dominated by GCN [ 4 , 25 , 7 , 6 ] and transformer-based architectures [ 26 , 8 ] due to their promising performance.
blocks.zh: 在早期的作品中,CNN [20,21,22] 和RNN [23,24] 的建筑常用于行动识别,而较近期的研究则以GCN [4,25,7,6] 和变压器为基础的建筑[26,8]为主,因为它们的性能很有希望.

blocks.en: Graph convolutional networks (GCNs) for skeleton-based action recognition were introduced by Yan et al. in the ST-GCN framework [ 27 ] . Subsequently, various techniques have been explored to improve model accuracy and robustness, including the use of adaptive data-driven topologies [ 4 , 28 ] , the expansion of spatial and temporal receptive fields [ 29 , 30 ] , adaptive feature aggregation [ 5 , 6 , 31 ] , and prompt-based learning strategies [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: Yan等人在ST-GCN框架中介绍了用于骨架行动识别的图解网络[27]。 随后,还探索了提高模型准确性和稳健性的各种技术,包括使用适应性数据驱动的地形[4,28],扩大空间和时间可接受领域[29,30],适应性特征汇总[5,6,31],以及即时学习战略[32].

blocks.en: In ST-TR [ 33 ] , vision transformers are employed for skeleton action recognition through the introduction of distinct spatial and temporal attention modules. Subsequent works have explored hybrid transformers by integrating transformers with GCNs [ 34 , 35 ] or temporal convolutions [ 36 ] , along with attention modules and developing parameter-efficient models [ 26 ] . Recent studies have demonstrated that mask modeling is an effective approach for training vanilla transformer networks. The proposed DiMoP adapts a vanilla ViT [ 37 ] as the encoder and extends transformers to function as both the denoising decoder and the pseudo-frame-based classifier.
blocks.zh: 在ST-TR [33]中,通过引入独特的空间和时间关注模块,将视觉变压器用于骨架动作识别. 随后的工程通过将变压器与GCN[34,35]或时间演化[36]进行集成,以及注意模块和开发参数效率模型[26]来探索混合变压器. 最近的研究表明,面具建模是训练香草变压器网络的有效方法. 拟议的DiMoP将一个香草VIT [37] 改装为编码器,并将变压器扩展为同时作为去诺化解码器和假帧式分类器的功能.

blocks.en: II-B Unsupervised Methods
blocks.zh: II-B 无监督的方法

blocks.en: Recent self-supervised approaches have employed contrastive [ 13 , 14 , 38 , 10 ] and generative methods [ 11 , 12 , 18 , 39 ] to learn meaningful representations from unlabeled data, thereby improving performance in multiple downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 最近的自我监督方法采用了对比性[13、14、38、10]和基因方法[11、12、18、39],从未加标签的数据中学习有意义的表述,从而提高了多项下游任务的绩效。

blocks.en: In contrastive learning, representations are learned by distinguishing between positive and negative pairs, which are typically generated using transformation functions that enhance the diversity of training samples. For instance, SkeletonCLR [ 38 ] employs shear and crop transformations. Recent studies demonstrate that stronger transformations, those that incorporate rich semantic information, can significantly improve generalizability and reduce the gap with fully supervised methods. Building on this idea, AimCLR [ 14 ] introduces extreme transformations to generate novel movement patterns, employing four spatial transformations (shear, spatial flip, rotation, axis mask), two temporal transformations (crop, temporal flip), and two spatio-temporal transformations (Gaussian noise, Gaussian blur). In contrast, ActCLR [ 13 ] applies extreme transformations only to static body parts to preserve critical motion-related information. Despite the introduction of various data transformations, many fail to effectively simulate the complex motion dynamics, limiting their ability to capture the full range of movement variations.
blocks.zh: 在对比性学习中,表现学是通过区分正对和负对来学习的,这些正对通常是利用增强训练样本多样性的转化功能产生的. 例如,SkeletonCLR[38]采用剪切和作物转化。 最近的研究显示,更强大的转变,那些包含丰富的语义信息的变化,可以大大提高通俗性,用充分监督的方法缩小差距. 基于这个想法,AimCLR[14]引入了极端变换以产生新颖的运动模式,采用了四个空间变换(耳机,空间翻转,旋转,轴罩),两个时间变换(crop,时间翻转),以及两个时空变换(高斯噪音,高斯模糊). 相比之下,ActCLR[13]只将极端变换应用于静态身体部分,以保存与运动相关的重要信息. 尽管引入了各种数据转换,但许多人未能有效地模拟复杂的运动动态,限制了他们捕捉全部运动变异的能力.

blocks.en: Masked Autoencoders (MAEs) [ 19 ] have recently been actively adopted in 3D action representation learning. Transformer-based MAEs were reported in SkeletonMAE [ 12 ] to reconstruct randomly masked joints. Specifically, visible joints are mapped to latent representations by the encoder, after which masked joints are replaced with fixed embeddings referred to as learnable tokens. These tokens, along with the latent representations of visible joints, are then fed into the reconstruction decoder to recover the masked joint coordinates. Subsequent works explored different masking operations or reconstruction targets to improve representation learning. For instance, in MAMP [ 17 ] , highly mobile joints were masked with a higher probability, and the original motion was reconstructed starting from learnable tokens. However, because every masked joint is represented by the same learnable token, the model’s ability to capture the variability inherent in human motion is limited. In contrast, in DiMoP, diffused joints are used to replace the conventional masked patches, thereby encouraging the network to learn a probabilistic mapping from noisy to clean joint configurations.
blocks.zh: 3D动作表现学习中最近积极采用Masked自动编码器[19]. 在SkeletonMAE [12] 中报告了基于变形器的MAEs,以重建随机遮盖的关节. 具体地说,可见关节被映射到编码器潜伏的表示,之后遮盖的关节被替换为固定的嵌入,称为可学习的代币. 这些标志,加上可见关节的潜在表示,然后被输入重建解码器,以恢复蒙面的联合坐标. 随后的作品探索了不同的蒙面行动或重建目标,以改善代表性学习. 例如,在MAMP[17]中,高度移动的关节被蒙上更高的概率,最初的运动是从可学习的标志开始重建的. 然而,由于每个遮盖的关节都用同样的可学习的符号来代表,模型捕捉人类运动所固有的变异性的能力是有限的. 相比之下,在DiMoP中,用分散的关节来取代传统的遮盖补丁,从而鼓励网络学习从吵闹到清洁的联合配置的概率映射.

blocks.en: Recently proposed MacDiff [ 11 ] employs a masked conditional diffusion framework where the denoiser is conditioned via global Adaptive Layer Normalization (AdaLN). The global representation, obtained by pooling the local features of visible joints from the semantic encoder, is used to uniformly scale and shift all feature channels in each denoiser layer. This global conditioning drives the denoising of the entire diffused skeleton, updating both visible and masked joints under the same modulation. Such global feature modulation provides coarse, sequence-level conditioning but lacks joint- or spatial-specific distinction. In contrast, DiMoP introduces a structured partial-state diffusion that diffuses only masked joints while keeping visible joints as clean anchors throughout the denoising. Instead of global AdaLN modulation, DiMoP performs token-level cross-conditioning via cross-attention; queries from noisy (masked) joints attend to keys/values from visible-joint embeddings, enabling localized, motion-aware guidance that MacDiff’s global feature modulation cannot achieve.
blocks.zh: 最近提出的MacDiff [11] 采用了一种隐蔽的有条件扩散框架,即通过全球适应层正常化(AdaLN)来对denoiser施加条件。 通过从语义编码器中汇集可见关节的局部特征而获得的全球代表,用于在每一个阴极层中统一缩放和改变所有特征通道. 这种全局调节驱动着整个分散骨架的消音,在相同的调制下更新可见和遮蔽的关节. 这种全球特征调制提供了粗糙的,序列级的调制,但缺乏联合或空间特异性的区分. 相比之下,DiMoP引入了结构化的部分态传播,这种传播只扩散遮盖的关节,同时将可见的关节作为整片的清洁锚. DiMoP不是全球的AdaLN调制,而是通过交叉调制来进行符号级的交叉调制;来自吵闹(混音)关节的询问来自显式联合嵌入的密钥/值,使得MacDiff的全球特性调制无法实现的本地化和运动感导.

blocks.en: III Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 三 拟议方法

blocks.en: III-A Overview
blocks.zh: 三. 概览

blocks.en: Figure 1 depicts the network architecture of the proposed method, DiMoP, which takes a raw skeleton sequence S S as input, where S ∈ ℝ T i ​ n × V × C i ​ n S\in\mathbb{R}^{T_{in}\times V\times C_{in}} , T i ​ n T_{in} , V V and C i ​ n C_{in} indicate the number of input frames, the number of joints, and the number of input channels, respectively. Following common practice in vision transformers [ 37 ] , a linear embedding layer is utilized to map the input joint coordinates into joint embeddings.
blocks.zh: 图1描绘了拟议方法的网络架构DiMoP,它以原始骨架序列S S作为输入,其中S ∈ R T i n → V → C i n S\in\mathb{R}^{ T_{in}\tims V\times C_{in}},T i n T_{in},V V和C i n C_{in}分别表示输入帧数,关节数和输入通道数. 按照视觉变压器的常见做法[37],使用线性嵌入层将输入联合坐标映射为联合嵌入.

blocks.en: The DiMoP network consists of four modules: an encoder E ⁡ ( ⋅ ) E(\cdot) , a denoising decoder D Denoise ​ ( ⋅ ) D_{\text{Denoise}}(\cdot) , a mapping layer g ⁡ ( ⋅ ) g(\cdot) , and a pseudo-classifier G psu ​ ( ⋅ ) G_{\text{psu}}(\cdot) , where all except the mapping layer follow the standard transformer architecture [ 40 ] .

blocks.en: Given a skeleton sample in the embedding space x 0 ∼ q ⁡ ( x 0 ) x_{0}\sim q(x_{0}) (where the subscript 0 denotes the original sample), a masking operation ℳ \mathcal{M} first decomposes x 0 x_{0} into two parts: the masked joints x 0 m x_{0}^{m} and the visible joints x 0 v x_{0}^{v} . In DiMoP, the term masking refers to an indexing operation that separates the input joints into visible and masked subsets rather than replacing the masked joints with zero or a fixed value. The visible joints x 0 v x_{0}^{v} are passed through the encoder E ⁡ ( ⋅ ) E(\cdot) to produce latent representations, while the masked joints x 0 m x_{0}^{m} retain their original values and go through the forward diffusion process. blocks.en: Cross Decoder V1: In this variant, each decoder block employs a cross-attention layer where noisy joints first attend to the latent representation of visible joints. Specifically, queries are computed through a linear projection of the noisy joints, while keys and values are derived solely from the linear projections of the latent visible joints. This iterative process denoises each noise patch conditioned on the constant visible information. One drawback is that each noisy joint attends independently to the visible joints, without considering the interactions among other noisy joints.

blocks.en: Cross Decoder V2: This configuration takes the complete joint set as input but treats visible joints as a separate conditioning branch. Queries are computed through a linear projection of the entire joint set, while keys and values are derived solely from the linear projections of the latent visible joints. This design preserves the global context in the queries by allowing each joint to benefit from interactions with the complete set, while the exclusive conditioning on visible joints ensures a stable and reliable guidance signal during denoising.

blocks.en: III-B 4 Pseudo-classifier
blocks.zh: 三-B 4 Pseudo分类器

blocks.en: The pseudo-frame classifier serves as an auxiliary head that imposes a frame-level discriminative constraint. In particular, the pseudo-classifier enforces temporal coherence by mapping all frames of a sequence toward a consistent label space, thereby suppressing frame-level noise and compacting sequence-level representations. Although not tied to true action labels, these homogeneous pseudo-labels act as latent surrogates that enhance feature separability and strengthen discriminative power for downstream recognition.
blocks.zh: 伪帧分类器作为辅助头,施加帧级的歧视性限制. 特别是,伪分类器通过将一个序列的所有帧都映射到一个一致的标签空间,从而抑制帧级噪声和紧凑的序列级代表来强制时间一致性. 这些同质的假标签虽然不与真实的动作标签挂钩,但却是潜在的替代物,可以增强特征的分离性并加强下游识别的歧视性力量。

blocks.en: While diffusion learning primarily reconstructs motion dynamics, it may yield overly smooth representations; the pseudo-classifier mitigates this by enforcing temporal consistency within actions and separation across distinct motion phases, effectively introducing an implicit temporal clustering signal that enhances inter-class separability and intra-action coherence without real labels. Specifically, the pseudo-frame-based classifier G p ​ s ​ u ​ ( ⋅ ) G_{psu}(\cdot) is driven by a random sequence and generates a homogeneous sequence conditioned on the encoder output u u .
blocks.zh: 传播学习主要可以重建运动动态,但可能产生过于平稳的表达方式;伪分类器通过在行动内部加强时间一致性和在不同的运动阶段进行分离来缓解这种情况,有效地引入一个隐含的时间集群信号,在没有真正标签的情况下加强阶级之间的分离性和行动内部的一致性。 具体来说,基于假帧的分类器G p s u (⋅) G _{ psu} (\cdot) 是由随机序列驱动的,并生成一个以编码器输出u u u 为条件的同质序列.

blocks.zh: 三-B 5 培训目标

blocks.en: The model is pre-trained using a combination of denoising loss and the homogeneity of the label sequences produced by the pseudo-classifier. The homogeneity loss is assessed by measuring the temporal smoothness and consistency of the pseudo-labels across the frames.
blocks.zh: 该型号采用去诺化损失和伪分类器生产的标签序列的同质性相结合的方式进行预训. 通过测量跨帧伪标签的时间光滑性和一致性来评估同质性损失.

Denoising loss: Unlike the standard denoising Diffusion Probabilistic
Models (DDPM) approach [ 41 ] , which often employs ϵ \epsilon -prediction for noise estimation, the proposed DiMoP model directly reconstructs the clean sample through a denoising process. In particular, DiMoP is trained to predict the motions of masked joints by denoising the noisy input, thus recovering the underlying motion distributions.

IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: The proposed DiMoP is evaluated on three commonly used large-scale datasets.
blocks.zh: 拟议的DiMoP在三个常用的大型数据集上得到评价.

blocks.en: IV-A 1 NTU RGB+D 60 [ 42 ]
blocks.zh: IV-A 1 NTU RGB+D 60 [42] (英语).

blocks.en: NTU RGB+D 60 is a large-scale dataset for human action recognition that contains 60 action categories performed by 40 subjects, totaling 56,880 skeleton sequences. The dataset is evaluated using two standard protocols: cross-subject (X-Sub) and cross-view (X-View). In the X-Sub protocol, action sequences from 20 subjects are used for training, while sequences from the remaining subjects are reserved for testing. In the X-View protocol, training samples are captured from cameras 2 and 3, while testing is conducted on samples from camera 1.
blocks.zh: NTU RGB+D 60是用于人类行动识别的大型数据集,包含由40个主体完成的60个动作类别,共计56,880个骨架序列. 该数据集使用两个标准协议进行评估:交叉主体(X-Sub)和交叉视图(X-View). 在X-Sub协议中,20个科目的动作序列用于培训,其余科目的序列则保留用于测试. 在X-View协议中,从2号和3号摄像机中采集培训样本,同时对照相机样本进行测试 一、导 言

blocks.en: IV-A 2 NTU RGB+D 120 [ 43 ]
blocks.zh: IV-A 2 NTU RGB+D 120 [43] (英语).

blocks.en: NTU RGB+D 120 extends NTU RGB+D 60 by doubling the action categories from 60 to 120. The dataset comprises 114,480 skeleton sequences and is evaluated using cross-subject (X-Sub) and cross-setup (X-Set) protocols. In X-Set, sequences are divided into 32 setups based on camera distance and background, with half allocated for training. The unique camera viewpoints ensure diversity in positions, angles, and backgrounds. The dataset covers a broad range of actions, including in-office activities, object interactions, fine-grained single-person actions (which are subject to occlusions and noise), and mutual interactions.
blocks.zh: NTU RGB+D 120延长NTU RGB+D 60,将动作类别从60个翻倍到120个. 数据集由114,480个骨架序列组成,使用交叉主体(X-Sub)和交叉设置(X-Set)协议进行评估. 在X-Set中,序列根据相机距离和背景分为32个设置,一半分配用于训练. 独特的镜头视角确保了位置、角度和背景的多样性。 该数据集涵盖广泛的动作,包括办公室内活动,对象互动,精细的单人动作(受到隔离和噪音的影响),以及相互的相互作用.

blocks.en: IV-A 3 PKUMMD [ 44 ]
blocks.zh: IV-A 3 PKUMD [44] (英语).

blocks.en: PKUMMD is a large-scale dataset for 3D human action recognition, divided into two parts. Part 1 contains over 1,000 action instances across 51 classes performed by 66 subjects, while Part 2 includes approximately 20,000 instances under more challenging conditions, characterized by increased variability, occlusion, and overlap.
blocks.zh: PKUMMD是用于3D人类动作识别的大型数据集,分为两部分. 第1部分载有66个科目的51个类别中1 000多个行动实例,而第2部分则包括大约20 000个在更具挑战性的条件下采取的行动实例,其特点是变化性增加、隔离和重叠。

blocks.en: These datasets provide complementary evaluation settings with distinct degradation factors and purposes. NTU RGB+D 60 serves as a standard benchmark for comparison with existing self-supervised skeleton representation learning methods, covering viewpoint changes, inter-subject variation, intra-class diversity, and skeleton tracking noise. NTU RGB+D 120 evaluates scalability and robustness in a larger and more diverse setting, with 120 action classes, 106 subjects from 15 countries, wide age and height ranges, multiple camera setups, fine-grained actions, object interactions, and diverse skeleton variations. PKUMMD assesses generalization under more realistic sequence-level challenges, including long continuous actions, action transitions, temporal ambiguity, subject overlap, and occlusion. Collectively, these datasets evaluate DiMoP across standard benchmark comparison, large-scale recognition, and challenging settings, while covering action classes with subtle, strong, and mixed subtle–strong motion patterns.
blocks.zh: 这些数据集提供了具有不同退化因素和目的的补充评价环境。 NTU RGB+D 60作为标准基准,用于与现有的自我监督的骨架表达学习方法进行比较,涵盖观点变化,主体间差异,类内多样性,骨架跟踪噪音. NTU RGB+D 120在更大和更多样化的环境下评价可伸缩性和稳健性,有120个动作课,来自15个国家的106个科目,宽年龄和高度范围,多个相机设置,细纹动作,物体相互作用,以及多种骨架变异. PKUMMD在更现实的序列级挑战下评估概括性,包括长期连续行动,动作过渡,时间模糊,主题重叠,以及隔离. 集成起来,这些数据集通过标准基准比较、大规模识别和具有挑战性的设置来评价DiMoP,同时涵盖动作类,包括微妙的、强的和混合的微妙的-强的动作模式。

blocks.en: The encoder was adapted from MAMP [ 17 ] . The model takes a 300-frame-long skeleton sequence as input, which is then cropped and interpolated to 60 frames. The patch size l l is set to 2 to generate non-overlapping temporal segments, which facilitates τ = 30 \tau=30 .

The encoder consists of eight layers, while the denoising decoder comprises five layers. The pseudo-classifier consists of cross-attention blocks. Before the first layer of each module, separate learnable spatial and
temporal positional embeddings are added to the input embeddings. A masking ratio of 0.9 is applied. For the forward diffusion process, a total of T = 300 T=300 sampling steps are used, and a linear noise scheduling scheme [ 45 ] is adopted.

blocks.zh: IV-D 1 面具策略和面具比率分析

blocks.en: Table V compares simple random masking with motion-aware random masking, implemented following [ 17 ] . Random masking achieves better performance because it uniformly exposes all joints to the denoising objective, whereas motion-aware masking may over-emphasize large-motion joints and under-sample subtle yet discriminative motions. Nevertheless, uniform masking is not intended to explicitly model structured occlusion. In scenarios with persistent joint occlusion, such as lower-body occlusion behind a desk, joint-confidence scores from the pose estimator could be incorporated into both the masking probabilities and denoising loss to avoid treating unreliable or unavailable joints as reconstruction targets. Table VI further shows that a high masking ratio of 90% yields the best performance.
blocks.zh: 表五将简单的随机掩码与运动意识随机掩码进行比较,在[17]之后实施. 随机遮罩可以实现更好的性能,因为它统一地将所有关节暴露在去诺氏目标上,而运动意识遮罩则可能过分强调大动关节和少见的微妙但具有歧视性的运动. 然而,统一遮盖并不是为了明确模拟结构化隔离。 在长期联合隔离的情景中,如桌子后面的下体隔离,姿势估计器的连带信心分数可纳入掩盖概率和排除损失,以避免将不可靠或没有的关节作为重建目标。 表六还显示,90%的高遮掩率表现最好。

blocks.en: To provide a more fine-grained analysis, the 60 action classes are grouped according to their motion characteristics: fine-grained single-person actions (G1), large body-motion actions (G2), hand-object interactions (G3), two-person interactions (G4) and weak-discriminative-frame actions (G5). As summarized in Table XII , DiMoP improves 47 out of 60 classes, corresponding to 78.3% of the actions, with an average gain of 1.90 percentage points over MAMP. Consistent improvements are observed across all groups, particularly for large body-motion actions and two-person interactions, where 91.7% and 90.9% of the classes are improved, respectively. These results indicate that progressive denoising facilitates the learning of both localized motion patterns and interaction-related dynamics. The relatively lower improvement ratios in hand-object and weak-discriminative-frame actions suggest that skeleton-only representations remain limited when object contact cues or short-lived discriminative frames are critical.

blocks.en: V Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: A diffusion-based framework, DiMoP, was introduced for skeleton representation learning to model motion dynamics by progressively adding noise and denoising skeleton joints. By replacing static masking and handcrafted transformations with a stochastic, iterative denoising process, DiMoP effectively captures the uncertainty inherent in skeletal motion and enhances generalization. In addition, a pseudo-frame-based classifier was proposed to inject a discriminative structure without requiring manual labels. The proposed method achieved state-of-the-art performance on three standard benchmarks in action classification.
blocks.zh: 采用了一种基于扩散的框架DiMoP,用于骨架代表学习,通过逐步增加噪音和去诺骨架关节来模拟运动动力学。 通过将静态遮罩和手动变换换换成一个有条理的,迭代的去诺化过程,DiMoP有效地捕捉了骨骼运动固有的不确定性,增强了概括性. 此外,还提议采用假框架分类法,在不需要人工标签的情况下注入歧视性结构。 拟议方法在行动分类的三个标准基准上取得了最新业绩。

blocks.en: However, DiMoP might be limited when discriminative cues are brief, highly localized, or dependent on object/contact information. For instance, actions such as headache and neck pain share similar hand-to-head/neck movements, where only a few frames carry discriminative evidence. The pseudo-frame classifier promotes sequence-level temporal consistency, which stabilizes representations but may suppress such short-lived cues. Moreover, object-centric actions such as wearing shoes , typing on a keyboard , or playing with a phone may remain challenging because skeleton-only input does not explicitly encode object appearance or precise hand-object contact. It should be noted that these issues are not unique to DiMoP; they also exist in existing methods such as MAMP and MacDiff.
blocks.zh: 不过,迪莫 当歧视提示简短、高度本地化或依赖于物体/接触信息时,P可能受到限制。 例如,头痛和颈痛等行为具有类似的手对头/颈运动,只有少数框架带有歧视性证据。 伪框架分类器促进序列级时间一致性,这稳定了表示,但可能抑制这种短命的提示. 此外,以对象为中心的动作,如穿鞋,键盘打字,或玩手机等,可能依然具有挑战性,因为仅刻骨的输入没有明确编码对象外观或精确的手物体接触. 应当指出,这些问题并非DiMoP独有;它们也存在于现有的方法中,如MAMP和MacDiff.

blocks.en: Future work will explore motion-adaptive diffusion scheduling and interaction between subjects. For instance, subtle moving joints will receive less noise or undergo slower denoising, while highly moving joints will retain full diffusion depth. This direction is expected to further improve the model’s ability to distinguish between complex and diverse motion patterns in real-world scenarios.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将探讨适应运动传播的时间安排以及主题之间的互动。 例如,细微的动关节会得到较少的噪声或接受较慢的调音,而高度移动的关节则会保持充分扩散的深度. 预计这一方向将进一步提高模型在现实世界情景中区分复杂和多样运动模式的能力。

blocks.en: Consequently, early diffusion steps with high SNR emphasize subtle motion modes, while later steps increasingly capture strong motion dynamics. Unlike direct masked regression, which is biased toward large residuals, latent diffusion with motion supervision distributes learning across the full spectrum of motion dynamics in a principled manner.
blocks.zh: 因此,具有高SNR的早期扩散步骤强调微妙的运动模式,而后来的步骤则越来越多地抓住强大的运动动态。 与偏重大片残留的直接遮掩回归不同,运动监督的潜在扩散以原则方式将学习分布在运动动力的方方面面。

blocks.en: Table XVIII provides a group-level interpretation of the class-wise results. The larger gain on subtle-motion actions suggests that DiMoP better preserves localized, low-amplitude cues that are easily dominated by stronger body movements in direct masked reconstruction. This indicates a key limitation of MAE-style objectives: reconstruction can be biased toward high-energy motion components, whereas progressive denoising exposes the model to fine deviations around the clean motion manifold at high-SNR stages. The gain on strong-motion actions further shows that DiMoP does not improve subtle actions at the expense of large-scale dynamics, but also retains global displacement, posture transitions, and interaction patterns through later denoising stages. Therefore, the observed improvements are not merely class-wise fluctuations; they indicate that DiMoP learns motion representations across multiple spatial and temporal scales.
blocks.zh: 表十八对分级结果进行了分组解释。 对微妙动作的更大收益表明,DiMoP更好地保留了局部,低照度的提示,在直接蒙面重建中很容易被更强大的身体运动所支配. 这表明了MAE类目标的关键局限性:重建可能偏向高能运动组件,而渐进的去诺则使模型在高SNR阶段的清洁运动多面体周围暴露出细微的偏差. 强动行动带来的收益进一步表明,DiMoP并不以牺牲大规模动态为代价改进微妙行动,而是通过后来的去名阶段保留了全球流离失所,姿态过渡和互动模式. 因此,所观察到的改进并不仅仅是类位波动;它们表明,DiMOP在多个空间和时间尺度上学习运动表达.
